machine: Flash (Vinay's Ubuntu box, ssh flash, 12 threads, qwen-test venv: python 3.14 + numpy 2.5.4 + tokenizers 0.23.3)

model_pair.local_note: downloaded on the Muse VM through Vinay's approved Hugging Face access (license request approved Oct 27) and copied to Flash; the pair was the Phase 3 item blocked by the HF license gate until the approval landed
model_pair.matrices: embedding (tied, also the LM head) + 16 blocks x (attn.q/k/v/o_proj, mlp.gate/up/down_proj) = 113 delta matrices

probe_set.source: the combined 96 fresh Spark probe items from Phase 1 (data/heldout_probes_spark.json's original 24 held-out + data/heldout72_probes_spark.json's 72 expansion items, combined by this script with Phase 1's subset tags); no pair's sweep saw them during search, Stage 1, or Stage 2

byte_matched_variant.name: no_embed_mlp_spread_balanced
byte_matched_variant.reason: Cut down and o_proj plus k/v by half and reduced gate/up to 64 to shed 10174464 bytes while keeping gate/up/q_proj as the three highest ranks.

price_validation.method: factored.storage_bytes summed over the 113 real matrices read from the model files, computed in the Flash build pass (same code path as Stage 2 pricing)

method.configs: base (no delta), full_delta (Instruct weights), and factored_delta per recipe: uniform_rank32, the Stage 2 winner, and the byte-matched variant
method.scoring: identical to third_pair Stage 2: Llama-3 chat prompt (system line 'You are a helpful assistant.'); target logprob = summed log-probability of the answer tokens; accuracy = first-token accuracy; gap_closed = (factored - base) / (full - base) on mean target logprob, per subset with that subset's own base/full references
method.forward_pass: the third_pair_stage2 NumPy Llama 3.2 forward, validated in Stage 2 by internal consistency (graft check, quantize_delta cross-check, full-delta-beats-base gap)

verdict.byte_fair_headline_question: does no_embed_mlp_spread_balanced beat uniform_rank32 on the combined 96 fresh items?
